properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 5 at 1:06PM EDT until October 5 at 3:00PM EDT by NWS Jacksonville FL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Glynn County in southeastern Georgia...

* WHEN...Until 300 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 105 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Brunswick, St. Simons Island, Sea Island, St Simons Island
Village and Jekyll Island.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 5 at 10:51AM CDT until October 7 at 1:00AM CDT by NWS St Louis MO
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Missouri...Illinois...

Mississippi River at Clarksville.

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Missouri...Illinois...

Mississippi River at Louisiana.

River forecasts are based on observed precipitation and forecast
precipitation for the next 48 hours.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Mississippi River at Clarksville.

* WHEN...Until late Tuesday night.

* IMPACTS...At 25.3 feet, The road to Port Marmac, a riverside
community of about 13 homes just south of Clarksville, begins
flooding.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:30 AM CDT Monday the stage was 25.2 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 10:30 AM CDT Monday was 25.2 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage this
evening and continue falling to 21.2 feet Monday, October 12.
- Flood stage is 25.0 feet.
